ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 30% high-intensity (white) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) patches are concentrated on the distal third of the left lobe and the distal fourth of the right lobe. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys detected along the left lobe trailing edge. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch transitioning to a convex curve at the outer distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several fine, unaligned light-colored linear marks are visible on the lower-right quadrant of the fluke surface, intersecting the dark pigmentation.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vertical white linear streak is visible near the medial-distal boundary of the right lobe.
